cleanup_rule: Occupied seconds include setup/cleanup where receipt says so. Cleanup reserve is a bound, not measured cleanup. Parallel occupied seconds must not be called critical-path time.
counter_rule: Cache included in input once; reasoning subset of output; provider request sums separate from baseline-filtered native UI counters, native Goal and supervisor cumulative counters. Unobserved/cancelled tails remain UNKNOWN.
goal_status_rule: Native Goal status comes only from a Goal receipt; router completed/cap/error status remains in its separate field. Earlier cohorts001..003 GLM native_goal_status erroneously carried router status; treat those values as router statuses and Goal status as UNKNOWN. Luna interrupted turn receipts remain interrupted even when a turn/completed notification exists.

model_provenance.candidate_identity_rule: Observed model receipt only; requested names and label suffixes do not establish actual family.

quiescence_rule: Cohorts001..004 quiescent was native-cgroup quiet only. Cohort005+ preserves native, held-group, client-tool and execution-unit flags separately; aggregate is false when any original flag is false, unknown if required flags absent. Supplemented permit-release proof is separate and does not rewrite original failure flags.
seed_apportionment_rule: Count unique actual actor attempt once in global totals; shared per-comparison allocation must state reference count and fraction, never erase failed originals.

seed_unique_actor_artifact_cost.comparison_apportionment: NONE_OBSERVED_STARTED_SEED_DEPENDENCY_CONSUMERS; artifact exposure beyond registry dependencies UNKNOWN
seed_unique_actor_artifact_cost.cost_rule: Global actual actor-attempt cost once; artifact reuse does not create another inference charge. Failed attempts retained.

snapshot_consistency: Each source captured independently; per-source hash pins identify the exact bytes used. Live receipts may advance after capture; this is not an atomic global state freeze.
